problem: Reduce VLA training/inference cost while providing a practical policy for low-cost community robot hardware and distributed inference.
contribution: SmolVLA combines a compact partially used SmolVLM-2 backbone with a flow-matching action expert and an asynchronous action-queue inference scheme.
algorithm: Project image/language/state tokens through frozen VLM features; reduce image tokens to64/frame and use the first16LLM layers. Train an action expert with interleaved cross/causal-self attention to generate50-action chunks using10flow steps. Async clients replenish an action queue and may drop observations judged near-duplicate in joint space.
observations: Image views, language and sensorimotor-state tokens. SO100 experiments use top/wrist cameras and SO101 top/side cameras; this differs from a single uncalibrated overview camera.
actions: Continuous robot action chunks with robot-specific state/action normalization. Synchronous real evaluation executes the whole chunk before observing again; simulation observes after each action.
embodiment_and_data: 450Mmain model, approximately100Maction expert;481community datasets,22.9Kepisodes/10.6Mframes. Real target datasets50demonstrations each; SO100/SO101, plus LIBERO and Meta-World simulation. Entire research project reports30KGPUhours, not a cheap local pretraining run.
experiments: LIBERO10trials/task and Meta-World10trials/task. Real evaluations use fractional subtask scores: pick/grasp earns0.5, full placement another0.5; sorting accumulates four0.25components. Main pretrained/multitask ablations and sync/async timing are separate studies.
baselines: ACT single-task, pi0 and SmolVLA multitask/pretraining variants; simulation table mixes source-paper baselines. Training mode, observations and score definitions need matching before claiming algorithmic superiority.

quantitative_result.value: Source sync versusasync averages78.3 versus73.3 on its fractional real-task score scale; sorting70→50, while reported mean completion time13.75→9.70s. Faster execution does not uniformly improve task performance. These are not all-or-nothing success probabilities under Explorer's task predicate.
quantitative_result.location: PDF p12 Figure5; fractional-score definitions p8-9

limitations: Community data are heterogeneous/noisy. Real and simulated feedback schedules differ. Joint-space near-duplicate filtering can miss changes in the world at unchanged joints, especially if only command estimates exist. Reported async speed and partial-credit scores cannot qualify safe physical control.
code_and_license: Paper uses LeRobot and releases a model; this review did not audit exact SmolVLA code/model licenses or execute the policy. Current LeRobot remote-inference APIs must be verified separately from the paper's original implementation.
hardware_adaptation: A relevant future SO101-compatible candidate after real processor/camera/state validation and profiling. Do not infer measured state from commands, or suppress visually changed observations just because estimated joints are unchanged. Keep queue age/hold/stop authority local.
